classicbar.configuration.title: ClassicBar Configuration
Show icons next to the bars
classicbar.config.general.display_toughn: Show the armor toughness bar when the player has armor toughness
classicbar.config.general.full_absorptio: Show absorption as a full-width bar instead of scaling with the current value
classicbar.config.general.full_armor_bar: Show armor as a full-width bar instead of scaling with the current value
classicbar.config.general.full_toughness: Show armor toughness as a full-width bar instead of scaling with the current value
classicbar.config.general.display_low_ar: Flash the armor bar when armor is critically low
classicbar.config.general.show_saturatio: Show a secondary overlay on the hunger bar indicating current saturation
classicbar.config.general.show_held_food: Preview how much hunger holding food in your hand would restore
classicbar.config.general.show_exhaustio: Show a fading overlay on the hunger bar indicating exhaustion progress toward the next hunger loss
classicbar.config.general.transition_spe: Speed multiplier for the held-food and held-drink preview pulse animation
classicbar.config.general.hunger_bar_col: Hex color of the hunger bar (e.g. #B34D00)
classicbar.config.general.hunger_bar_deb: Hex color of the hunger bar when the Hunger effect is active
classicbar.config.general.saturation_bar: Hex color of the saturation overlay bar
Hex color of the saturation bar when the Hunger effect is active
Hex color of the air/breath bar
classicbar.config.general.lava_bar_color: Hex color of the lava charm protection bar
classicbar.config.general.flight_bar_col: Hex color of the flight duration bar
classicbar.config.general.frozen_health_: Hex color of the health bar when the player is frozen
classicbar.config.general.armor_color_va: Hex colors for each armor tier bracket, from lowest to highest
classicbar.config.general.armor_toughnes: Hex colors for each armor toughness tier bracket, from lowest to highest
classicbar.config.general.absorption_col: Hex colors for absorption hearts, indexed by number of absorption hearts
classicbar.config.general.absorption_poi: Absorption bar colors when the player is poisoned
classicbar.config.general.absorption_wit: Absorption bar colors when the player is withered
Health bar gradient colors at each fraction threshold (pairs with Normal Health Fractions)
classicbar.config.general.normal_fractio: Health fraction thresholds (0.0–1.0) that trigger each color in Normal Health Colors
classicbar.config.general.poisoned_color: Health bar gradient colors when the player is poisoned
classicbar.config.general.poisoned_fract: Health fraction thresholds for the poisoned color gradient
classicbar.config.general.withered_color: Health bar gradient colors when the player is withered
classicbar.config.general.withered_fract: Health fraction thresholds for the withered color gradient
classicbar.config.general.left_order.too: Names of bars shown on the left side of the HUD, ordered from bottom to top
classicbar.config.general.right_order.to: Names of bars shown on the right side of the HUD, ordered from bottom to top
classicbar.config.toughasnails.show_hydr: Show a secondary overlay on the thirst bar indicating current hydration
classicbar.config.toughasnails.show_held: Preview how much thirst holding a drink in your hand would restore
classicbar.config.toughasnails.show_thir: Show a fading overlay on the thirst bar indicating thirst exhaustion progress
classicbar.config.toughasnails.thirst_ba: Hex color of the thirst bar
Hex color of the thirst bar when the Thirst effect is active
classicbar.config.toughasnails.hydration: Hex color of the hydration overlay bar
Hex color of the hydration bar when the Thirst effect is active
classicbar.config.thirst_was_taken.thirs: Hex color of the Thirst Was Taken thirst bar
Hex color of the quenched (saturation) overlay on the thirst bar
classicbar.config.homeostatic.homeostati: Hex color of the Homeostatic water bar
Hex color of the Homeostatic hydration overlay bar
classicbar.config.homeostatic.show_hydra: Show a secondary overlay on the water bar indicating current hydration
